## Analysis

Joint translation/orientation optimization of three identical copies produced no gain, refuting the last unfrozen version of equal-scale copy composition. The persistent 473-element plateau also indicates that spare capacity alone is not useful; improvements require changing collision geometry, not adding points. Sol_0029 remains evidence that affine unions work, but recent searches varied only placement and reflection. Relative dilation between copies is the main untested structural degree of freedom and can reorganize sum and difference collisions substantially.
